name: Zutto Issho
source:
The main game's hero has to start living by his own when his parents had gone due to a job transfer. He got an apartment and started living with a girl. 

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/Z/SLPS-01238.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母因工作调动离开后，他不得不开始独自生活。他租下一间公寓，与一名女孩开始共同生活。

（来源：[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/Z/SLPS-01238.html]psxdatacenter[/url]）
